items.title: Market reaction to changes in Congress, AMD earnings, and where to find value in healthcare stocks
items.summary:
Host and "The Buy Side" author Turney Duff and his panel of experts weigh in on market reactions to the midterms, the AMD earnings report and what it means for investors, and where to find value in the healthcare sector.

Today's panel includes Drew Pettit, Chief Investment Strategist at Roundhill Investments; Mario Tufano, Senior Portfolio Manager at CS McKee; Emily Peck, Markets Reporter at Axios; and Al Root, Associate Editor at Barron's.

items.summary:
